guardrails: none: no citation gate, no critic, fix not forced to need approval
rationale: recommendationservice latency-90 and latency-50 rose by about 4467% and 3096% (z=+893 and +619), far more than any other series, and frontend latency rose as its downstream effect. Its downstream productcatalogservice shows flat latency and no error or warning logs exist, and no CPU, memory or other resource metrics for recommendationservice appear in the top series, so the fault looks like injected delay, but the digest cannot rule out other types with certainty.

proposed_fix.description: Inspect recommendationservice for injected network latency (e.g. tc netem rules or a delay fault) and remove it. If none is found, restart the recommendationservice pods and compare latency afterward.
